answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 170 Country: India Title: Please, tell me what happens when a husband having sex with his wife intentally or mistakenly sucks her milk? Question: Please, tell me what happens when a husband having sex with his wife intentally or mistakenly sucks her milk? Answer ID: 170 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 380/J) It is prohibited (haram) for a husband to drink the milk of his wife , but this does not nullify the nikah : الرضاع بعد مدتہ حرام لانہ جزء آدمي، والانتفاع بہ بغیر ضرورة حرام علی الاصح (کذا في شرح الوھبانیة 1/135 کتاب الرضا ع، و نقلہ عنہ في الدر مع الرد 4/397 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
